findings.statement: 期末20669.3减初始20000，净损益669.3元，与完整15日日损益合计一致；初始资本收益率为0.033465。保留了8个期末空仓日。
买入成本10010+5=10015元；卖出净收入10689.3−5=10684.3元；已实现净损益669.3元，已包含双边费用和成交价中的滑点，不能再次扣减。买单realized_pnl为空不代表该字段观测值为零。
同成交路径参考损益=(107−100)×100=700元。佣金合计10元，滑点合计20.7元，700−10−20.7=669.3。加回成本仅形成账务桥接，不能视为零成本策略反事实。
期初、期末均无库存，整个区间未实现损益变动为0；净损益=已实现669.3+未实现变动0。期间浮盈并非始终为零，例如1月10日为485元，卖出日转回485元，故当日净损益为669.3−485=184.3元。
唯一连续库存段为asset_01，1月2日买入100调整单位、1月13日全部卖出，冻结会话索引8−1=7。完整平仓段1个，右删失段0个。3会话复核间隔不等于持有期限；公开定义明确复核本身不提交订单。
2020-01-21期末库存股票数为0，因此“期末唯一持仓股票未实现损益”不适用，不能填0或指定某只股票。可确定为0的是组合期末未实现损益。
15日×2股共30个股票日，28个因filter_false在信号阶段排除；候选及共同样本均为1月1日的2只股票，候选事件排除数0。三期限共同样本哈希一致，但两个同日事件不能当作两个独立研究样本。
信号于1月1日收盘后观察，1月2日开盘进入、1月3日开盘退出。两股毛收益分别为101/100−1=0.01、198/200−1=−0.01，等事件均值0；均值抵消不表示各事件均无变化。
共同事件均从1月2日开盘计至1月9日开盘，两股收益0.06、0.04，均值0.05。该数值不含成本，也未采用实际单股持仓和现金权重。
共同事件均从1月2日开盘计至1月16日开盘，两股收益0.10、0.09，均值0.095。长端均值较高仅描述这两个事件，不能确定最优持有期、显著性或信号预测力。

按目标约定反推期望单位：1月2日为0.5×20000/100=100；其后至1月10日，权重×(9985+100×当日open)/open均约为100；1月13日起为0，asset_02始终为0，与成交重建库存一致。权重变化可由估值变化解释，未显示提前清仓目标未成交的差异。逐股盯市也能重建：合同指定open为日终标记，例如1月9日asset_01市值10600、成本10015、未实现损益585元。故summary关于逐股盯市不可得的通用提示不适用于本包的全部证据；真实报价到达与拒单原因仍不可识别。

现有证据足以核对合成账务和事件端点收益，不足以回答日频现象是否具有可推广的预测力。最需核对的是研究与执行的对应关系：事件研究覆盖两只信号股的1/5/10期毛收益，执行仅为预声明的asset_01两笔订单、7期持仓及部分资金投入，两者统计对象不同。1月2日起过滤值均为0，持仓延续不能解释为持续出现合格信号；目标与成交一致也不能证明订单由信号生成。单一信号日期、缺少同日非信号对照，无法区分信号效应与共同价格走势。

next_test.method: 下一项选择预注册的同日匹配事件检验，以区分信号相关后续收益与共同价格走势：在未暴露的冻结样本中固定信号、过滤及对照匹配规则，对信号股与同日可比非信号股统一使用t+1进入、t+h+1退出，报告1/5/10期配对超额收益；保留候选及排除记录，并按日期处理依赖。预先指定主要期限，避免看完曲线再选期限。本轮不执行该检验或新回测。
next_test.required_evidence: 多个未暴露信号日期、同日非信号股票及预先定义的风险匹配特征、信号和特征的实际可用时间记录、完整冻结日历及所需端点价格。现有两只股票在唯一信号日均合格，后续28个非信号股票日不能替代同日对照。
next_test.observation_supporting: 若信号股相对同日匹配对照在预指定期限仍有稳定正超额收益，且跨日期成立、并非少数事件或样本排除驱动，则支持现象具有预测信息，仍需另行检验策略执行。
next_test.observation_refuting: 若对照呈现相近的长端上涨、配对超额收益接近零或为负，或结果仅由当前日期及少数事件驱动，则削弱信号效应解释，支持共同走势或样本偶然性解释。

self_check.assessment: 仅使用公开普通资料及已有6次查询证据，无新增查询、工具执行或回测。金额及收益按原始订单和端点价格复核，浮点尾差在规定容差内。已区分零值与不适用、复核周期与库存期限、事件毛收益与账户净收益；完整性仅针对15个冻结合成会话。查询次数、期限数量及事件数量均未当作独立研究重复，未宣称真实策略成功。
self_check.next_step: 保留本次账务与口径诊断；取得预注册同日对照及未暴露日期证据后，实施上述一项事件检验。在此之前，研究有效性与真实执行能力继续列为未证实。

rejected_action.error: non-numeric finding must not contain a number

response.ordering: Archived chronological order; source_ordinal is zero-based and preserves same-day order.

coverage.calendar_basis: Every archived daily row is retained; no separate exchange calendar is accessed.

holding_path.definition: Continuous nonzero adjusted-unit inventory per stock; not FIFO lot age or independent trades.
holding_path.right_censored_observed_sessions_meaning: First chronological open-spell ages, not completed holding durations; all open spells are retained in tables.spells where status=right_censored.

interpretation: Same-filled-path reference PnL is an additive accounting bridge, not a zero-cost counterfactual strategy.
Realized net PnL already includes entry and exit costs; do not subtract fees or slippage again.
All archived days, cash days, positive/negative closed spells and right-censored spells remain in denominators.
Long inventory duration is observed; absence of reject/mark data prevents attribution to suspension, selection persistence or stale marks.
Arithmetic reconciliation does not certify raw-share T+1, corporate actions, tax lots, capacity or out-of-sample alpha.

actual_raw_share_inventory.reason: No independent raw-share and corporate-action event ledger.

counterfactual_zero_cost_sharpe.reason: Adding recorded costs back keeps endogenous quantities and is not a new counterfactual backtest.

execution_capacity.reason: No auction depth, queue, fill or capacity evidence.

fifo_tax_lot_holding_age.reason: Frozen simulator uses adjusted units and weighted average cost, not FIFO tax lots.

mark_staleness_by_stock.reason: Per-stock mark timestamps and missing-price state were not archived.

market_industry_style_attribution.reason: No predeclared benchmark, exposure or matched-control observations.

overnight_intraday_pnl.reason: Per-stock opening and closing marks for the complete held inventory are absent.

per_stock_daily_marked_pnl.reason: Daily archive contains only aggregate position value.

rejected_order_reason.reason: Only executed orders are present; target weights are intentions.

session_coverage.scope: Coverage against the controller-frozen calendar only; not independent exchange certification.

denominators.universe_identity: all supplied symbols and development session labels, including no-signal days

response.identity_assurance: Controller-frozen input declaration; content hashes do not certify source arrival or execution.
limitations: Gross endpoint event returns, not executable portfolio returns, selected stocks or actual holding spells.
Eligibility is a signal-close property; future endpoint availability is a separate descriptive sample restriction.
Only requested entry/exit prices are required; intermediate bars, trading availability and fills are not certified.
Calendar completeness and historical field arrival are inherited input assumptions, not independently certified here.
Availability timestamps use the declared nominal session clock, not supplier publication receipts; outcomes are post-signal diagnostics.
Overlapping events, shared stocks and shared dates are dependent; no significance test or independent sample count.
No groups, matched controls, causal attribution, fees, corporate-action cashflows or Sharpe score.
Event IDs and sample hash bind coordinate membership only; identity and payload hashes must also match to compare evidence.
Excluded candidate events remain in the full artifact, including individually available shorter outcomes.

public_packet.ordinary_input: 有一项按日识别市场现象的研究，资料中保存了研究定义和一份完整的固定合成执行记录；订单并非由完整策略回测生成。请检验现有证据能否回答这个研究问题，解释你认为最需要核对的差异，并选择能区分主要解释的下一项检验。可以报告证据不足。

execution_definition.valuation_convention: The same session synthetic open is the explicit end-of-session mark.
execution_definition.review_schedule: Every three session indices starting at zero; review does not itself submit an order.
execution_definition.target_weight_convention: Pre-open desired adjusted units valued at that open divided by pre-open cash plus inventory value; all symbols and dates retained.
execution_definition.order_source: Two predeclared fixture orders; orders are not generated by a target-weight backtest.

data_dictionary.daily: date,balance,net_pnl,return,cash,position_value,commission,slippage,turnover,trade_count are original saved rows. Other _cny/count fields are derived diagnostics; source_ordinal retains original row order.
data_dictionary.trades: Original executed orders; source_order_ordinal preserves same-day order. price already includes slippage; commission is separate; blank buy realized_pnl is unavailable, not zero.
data_dictionary.session_calendar: Independently frozen synthetic session list; completeness means coverage of this fixture, not certification of an exchange calendar.
data_dictionary.inventory: Weighted-average adjusted-unit inventory accounting. This table does not supply per-stock marks or rejected-order logs; a missing table field alone does not determine what can be derived from all other public evidence.
data_dictionary.horizon_inputs: Historical synthetic date/symbol/open/signal_value/eligible/score/filter_value. Signals are observed after close; t+1 entry and t+h+1 exit use the supplied calendar. Outcome prices are historical diagnostic evidence, not then-available features.
data_dictionary.horizon_curve: Equal-event gross endpoint returns on one common set for fixed horizons [1,5,10], with all excluded candidate events retained.
data_dictionary.event_identity: event_id = sha256(canonical {signal_date,symbol}); common_sample_hash = sha256(canonical {observation_unit:eligible_signal_stock_days,event_ids:chronological then symbol ordered common IDs}); canonical JSON uses sort_keys=True,separators=(comma,colon),ensure_ascii=False,UTF-8.

tool_contract.evidence_reference: Use the returned outer evidence_id; public_package_hash also identifies the ordinary packet.
tool_contract.scope: Controller-provided JSON only; no filesystem, SQL, external network, evaluator feedback or other research runs.

terminal_single_stock_unrealized_cny.definition: Unrealized PnL of the sole stock with nonzero inventory at the final session. Only applicable when exactly one stock remains; identify that date and stock. With zero or multiple terminal stocks this scalar is not applicable, not zero.

closed_duration_sessions.definition: maximum duration among fully closed continuous inventory spells
